name: YouTube Sticky Display
summary: PB&J Squad YouTube subscribers, views, and video count on reTerminal Sticky.
description: A native ESP32-S3 firmware that renders PB&J Squad channel totals on the reTerminal Sticky's 800x480 E-Ink display. It calls YouTube directly, so it does not require an always-running companion server.

compatibility.notes: ESP32-S3 with SSD1677 800x480 E-Ink panel and GT911 touch controller. Experimental until physically tested.

assets.previewAlt: YouTube channel totals rendered on a reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Configure before first refresh
notes.description: On first boot, connect to the Sticky-YT setup network and enter Wi-Fi credentials, a YouTube Data API key, and the channel ID or @handle. The key is stored on the device and can be extracted with physical access.

notes.title: Stock firmware recovery
notes.description: Flashing replaces the installed firmware. Keep the official stock recovery image available while testing.
